articles.headline: Asian Stocks Skid as Wall Street Aided by Oil Slip
articles.brief: Asian markets fell sharply while Wall Street and bonds found relief following a notable drop in global oil prices, driven by evolving geopolitical shifts and supply outlooks.

articles.headline: Oil Tumbles on Trump's Russia Sanctions Waiver
articles.brief: Crude prices dropped significantly after a waiver on Russian sanctions by Donald Trump raised expectations of increased fuel supplies reaching the global market.

articles.headline: Samsung to Use TSMC Technology for Nvidia Chips
articles.brief: Reports indicate Samsung will leverage TSMC manufacturing technology to build next-generation memory chips for Nvidia, marking a strategic shift in the semiconductor industry.

articles.headline: Accenture Explores Sale of Chinese Operations
articles.brief: Professional services giant Accenture is reportedly exploring a sale of its Chinese business division, valued at up to $1.5 billion, amid changing market dynamics.

articles.headline: Trump Endorses Netanyahu in Close Israeli Election
articles.brief: US President Donald Trump has offered a strong endorsement of Benjamin Netanyahu as Israel faces a tightly contested political race.

articles.headline: Iran Warns US and Israel Against Further Escalation
articles.brief: Iranian officials issued sharp warnings against potential military action, daring leaders to test regional resolve as tensions across the Middle East continue to mount.

articles.headline: Egypt Ready to Back Saudi Arabia Against Houthis
articles.brief: Cairo has officially stated its readiness to support Saudi Arabia in military efforts against Iran-allied Houthi movements, strengthening regional alliances.

articles.headline: France Shaken by Violent Protests and City Hall Riots
articles.brief: Violent demonstrations across French cities resulted in torched municipal buildings and widespread looting, prompting sharp condemnation from national leaders.

articles.headline: India Widens Cancer Drug Price Caps on 137 Medicines
articles.brief: The Indian government has expanded price controls on cancer therapeutics, drastically reducing the cost of 137 essential medicines to improve healthcare accessibility.

articles.headline: China Economic Growth Rebounds to 4.5% in Third Quarter
articles.brief: China's economic recovery gained unexpected momentum in the third quarter, reporting a 4.5% growth rate that surpassed analyst expectations.

articles.headline: India to Participate in SCO Regional Summit in Tajikistan
articles.brief: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh will represent India at the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation meeting, focusing on regional connectivity, trade, and multilateral security.

articles.headline: Ladakh Receives Dedicated High Court Bench After Decades
articles.brief: Nearly a century after the establishment of the Jammu and Kashmir High Court, a dedicated judicial bench has officially been inaugurated in Ladakh.
